response.consequence: Replay summaries sent to Seer can include wrong or mismatched error titles, messages and timestamps. Errors can be attributed to the wrong time in the breadcrumb timeline. This happens whenever some error nodes are missing or cached.
response.explanation: nodestore.backend.get_multi deduplicates ids and returns a dict keyed by node_id. The Django backend only returns rows that exist, and cached items are merged in last, so the values are not in error_ids order. They can also be fewer than error_ids. zip(error_ids, events.values()) pairs each error ID with whichever payload happens to sit at that position. If one error node is missing or the cache and DB results are mixed, every later error gets another event's title, message and timestamp. The `id` field is also not the real event ID.
response.title: Error IDs mispaired with nodestore results via zip(error_ids, events.values())
